headline: Huaxing Light: Revenue to jump next year, visibility seen through end of 2028 | Industry & Finance
summary: Optical communications maker Huaxing Light said EML mass production shipments began this quarter. It expects second-half performance to grow significantly over the first half, with new-product capacity fully used next year.
why: Huaxing Light makes optical components used in data center interconnects, a segment tied to demand for cloud and AI infrastructure.
